reason: YouTube Studio already tells me which videos beat my usual views, and I can see my own comments. Mitra sounds like the same data with a Monday email on top, and I live in WhatsApp, not my inbox. I need to see it find something I couldn't have seen in Studio before I pay anything.
objection: What does it know that Studio doesn't, and does it understand a Hinglish or Telugu audience, or does it hand me generic advice like every other AI tool?
would_change_my_mind: A free look at one real video where it caught something specific that Studio missed, delivered on WhatsApp.
